$note: Curated fill values for fields CMF marks IsMandatory but leaves NULL for many records, with NO declared DefaultValue (so fetchTemplateRows' CMF-default fill can't supply one). The export fills a BLANK cell with the object's own dominant real value so the file passes the required-field check with a VALID value — each value is verified against live CMF's distinct Type values (Checklist has no 'Standard', its default is 'General'; Flow/Product/DataCollection/BOM are 'Standard'). Applied ONLY to a blank cell; a record that has a real value keeps it. Keyed ObjectType.Column. Consumed by lib/chat-cmf/fill-from-existing.ts.
